title: Redefining Retrieval Evaluation in the Era of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how the position of a relevant passage within a context window of irrelevant or distracting passages affects the LLM's end-to-end answer accuracy (e.g., the "lost-in-the-middle" effect), and modeling this bias using learned positional weights in a novel retrieval evaluation metric (UDCG).
